kpi.name_fr: Ventes annuelles des produits Our Brands

2017.extrait: In 2017, Our Brands achieved its highest-ever unit share of items sold and reached $20.9 billion in total sales.

2019.extrait: 2019 was Our Brands' best year ever, exceeding $23.1 billion in sales.

2020.extrait: Record Our Brands sales of $26.2 billion, up 13.6%.

2023.extrait: Increase annual sales of affordable, quality Our Brands portfolio of products: $30B, $31B, $32B.

2024.extrait: Increase annual sales of affordable, quality Our Brands portfolio of products: $30B, $31B, $32B.

2025.extrait: Approximately $39B Our Brands Business; in FY2025 Kroger restated its sales definitions for Our Brands.

note: Six exercices publiquement vérifiés. Les exercices 2016, 2018, 2021 et 2022 restent nuls. La valeur 2025 suit une définition des ventes Our Brands retraitée par Kroger et n'est donc pas strictement comparable aux exercices antérieurs.
